propositions: The test oracle failed because it retried the batched Git walk but called resolve_event_commit exactly once per equivalence assertion, making it vulnerable to transient failures that the batched side recovered from.

Production resolve_event_commit intentionally maps all Git errors, timeouts, and exceptions to None as fail-closed behavior; the test fixture must mirror this with bounded retry, not alter production semantics.

A test-local bounded helper _fixture_per_event_commit now retries the per-event oracle up to five attempts and returns only non-None SHA values, preserving exact equivalence assertions and fail-closed contract.
Transient failures (rc128, rc0/empty, BlockingIOError(EAGAIN)) on both broad and narrow git-log calls now recover identically on retry when the underlying Git topology is unchanged.
